title: Add a sanctioned recovery path for orphaned IN_PROGRESS tasks with no claimant
description: TASK-186 has been IN_PROGRESS since before 2026-07-18 with claimed_by, lease_expires_at and heartbeat_at all NULL. Verified 2026-07-22 that MAP has NO sanctioned way to recover this shape: expire_leases() only matches a non-null expired lease; release_task()/submit_task() require claimed_by to equal the caller; map_task.py rework requires CHANGES_REQUESTED; map_task.py reject requires SUBMITTED. AGENTS.md forbids hand-editing SQLite, so the task is structurally unreachable by every recovery mechanism and by every operator-facing verb. This is why it stalled for four days and why the advisory monitor could only observe it, never fix it. Add an explicit, auditable recovery verb.
acceptance_criteria: A sanctioned function and CLI verb returns an IN_PROGRESS task whose claimed_by is NULL to READY, requiring an actor and a written reason, and refusing to touch a task that has a live claimant or an unexpired lease.
The action appends a durable event naming the actor, the prior owner, and the reason, so orphan recovery is auditable rather than silent.
Tests cover the orphan shape, refusal when claimed_by is set, refusal when the lease is still live, and refusal for statuses other than IN_PROGRESS.
TASK-186 is returned to READY using the new verb, not by hand-editing SQLite or task JSON.
